tests.test: Unauthenticated visitor cannot access assessment/intake/questions/results/API data.
Config contains exactly 24 capacity core items.
Each of 12 domains contains exactly 2 scored core items.
No automatic deep-dive questions are shown in V3.
Coach clarifiers never change domain/pillar/KCI scores.
Personal intake responses never change Capacity scores.
Domain scoring for responses 4 and 2 equals 75.
Mifflin male: 35y, 180cm, 90kg.
Mifflin female: 40y, 165cm, 70kg.
Male example REE 1855 with PAL 1.6.
Initial TDEE UI displays estimate/range and uncertainty, not exact metabolism.
Any clinical safety gate blocks autonomous calorie/fasting/training prescription as configured.
Age <18 blocks Personalized Calorie Index.
BMI <18.5 + weight-loss goal blocks calorie deficit.
Calculated target <1200 kcal/day is not auto-published.
Weight-loss target starts within 10-20% deficit only after coach approval.
Maintenance/recomp output defaults around TDEE ±5%.
Resistance-trained healthy adult gets protein logic within 1.4-2.0 g/kg/day when appropriate.
Kidney/relevant medical condition prevents automated high-protein target.
Nutrition plan surfaces WHO fruit/veg >=400g, fibre >=25g, free sugar <10%, sat fat <10%, trans fat <1%, salt <5g/day as guidance/benchmarks.
Hydration UI labels EFSA 2.0/2.5 L as total water including food + beverages, not mandatory plain water.
Sweat-rate module calculates (pre-post+fluid-urine)/hours correctly.
Adult sleep plan uses 7-9h as general target range and flags apnea symptoms for medical assessment.
Novice with 0 strength days and limited recovery is not assigned 4 hard workouts/week.
Training plan respects available days, time, equipment, injuries and dislikes.
Fasting uninterested -> no fasting recommendation.
Eating-disorder risk/pregnancy/relevant medication -> fasting blocked.
Sauna/cold are never selected as Big 3 ahead of unmet foundational sleep/nutrition/activity needs.
Plan generator produces exactly 3 candidate Big 3 priorities with rationale, weekly action and fallback action.
Client cannot see generated plan until coach approves.
14-day calorie calibration requires >=8 usable morning weights and adherence data.
One-day weight change never triggers calorie adjustment.
Week-12 reassessment repeats exact same 24 Capacity Core version as baseline for comparison.
Historical assessment/plan versions are immutable.
Religious/spiritual and health data are protected as sensitive data with role-based access and data minimisation.
No diagnostic labels are generated from Capacity scores or intake answers.
